note: Changes to a mapped trail's activities, each backed by something a land manager published. A correction that matches no trail stops the bake. Only add what a primary source says, and remove a listing when a primary source contradicts it.

official.note: Maryland DNR's map shows this as a designated ORV trail, 3.2 miles. Off-road vehicles need a Maryland permit decal.
official.label: DNR's map of this trail

corrections.name: Piney Mountain Road
corrections.reason: OpenStreetMap tags it ATV-designated, but Maryland DNR's trail inventory marks the Piney Mountain trails closed to ATVs, apart from an accessible hunter road. Treated as closed to general ATV riding.

corrections.name: Burkholder Road ATV Trail
corrections.reason: Only the OpenStreetMap name says ATV. Maryland DNR's trail inventory lists this road's trail as seasonal, contact DNR, under a snowmobile trail name. Not listed as open ATV riding without DNR's confirmation.
